column1: # visit_talk_words.tsv -- the words the evening-retro small talk reads
# venue-traits). Rule-based, no embeddings: a word here is the whole rule.
# Code stays ASCII (tools/nonascii-ratchet.py); the Korean lives here.
#   join      a party person named in the same clause JOINED the visit
#   home      a later round / a move ending at a home: the whole round text
#             equals the word, or ends with "네" / "네 집" (형석이네)
#   move      a move verb for a line without rounds ("끝나고 형석이네 가서")
#   life      a person fact worth bringing up later (new job, move, wedding)
#   ack       a bare acknowledgement: never a person note by itself
#             (the framework maintainer's DGN-2120 parallel namespace: mood quiet|lively,
#             wait short|long, portion small|large, service attentive|slow)
#   negate    right before a trait word flips its value (안 시끄러 -> quiet)
#   drinks    a place-page category word that makes a venue drinks_friendly
